operators.name: mean_dim0
semantics: Computes mean over dimension 0 (batch dimension) with reduction size 16.
Output shape is [3, 4096, 4096], matching torch.mean(x, dim=0).
Uses floating-point accumulation; implementation should use a stable reduction (e.g., parallel reduction) to match reference numerical behavior.
Returned tensor is newly allocated contiguous on CUDA.

operators.name: hardswish
semantics: Applies hardswish activation: x * clip(x + 3, min=0, max=6) / 6.
Returned tensor is newly allocated contiguous on CUDA.
Reduction over batch dimension (size 16) producing channel-wise mean.
Output shape [3, 4096, 4096], dtype float32, CUDA tensor.
Applies hardswish activation element-wise: x * min(max(x + 3, 0), 6) / 6.
Output shape remains [3, 4096, 4096], dtype float32, CUDA tensor.
Returns the resulting tensor [3, 4096, 4096], dtype float32, CUDA tensor.
